page.layout: Top: running head with page number at upper left. One text column with a centred italic dedication block at the top, then the body text in one column, with a large initial D. No marginal notes. No catchword or signature.

p.i: Reverendo Patri, atqve eruditissimo Domino meo Patri Jo. Morino Congregationis Oratorii Presbytero Petrus à Valle Peregrinus S.P.D.

main_text.p: Doctissimæ Exercitationes, qvas à te nuper elaboratas, dilecte mi Pater, semperqve observande Morine, uti pollicitus fueras, ad me misisti, à R. R. Patribus Congregationis tuæ mihi redditæ fuerunt; earum lectione mirum in modum sum delectatus: nec prius ad te re-scribere volui, qvam illas, ut feci, à principio ad finem avidissime evolverem. Omnia reperi, sicut jam mente conceperam, non minus doctrina qvam curiosa novitate, & summa demum eruditione referta, qvæ præcipue, de Cabbala ex-plicasti, mihi perjucunda fuere: diue-nim aliqvid certi rescire concupiveram de reconditis istis Judæorum mysteriolis; non tamen ab ipsis, qvos in omni scientia vanissimos esse jampridem com-pereram. De Cabbalisticis hisce inter-pretationibus, ex Arabum, Persarumq; ac Turcarum Monumentis, à Talmudi-stis,

page.notes: Page number "228" at upper left is partly smudged; read as 228. The dedication line "Jo." is printed with a J and was kept as printed. Spaces before commas and semicolons in the body are printing spacing and were not copied. Hyphenated line breaks are kept as printed: Congrega-tionis, Val-le, Do-mino, re-scribere, ex-plicasti, diue-nim, com-pereram, inter-pretationibus, Talmudi-stis. The text continues on the next page.
